result.instructions: LightCraft is a non-destructive photo library and raw developer (a Lightroom alternative). Photos have integer ids; most editing acts on the *active* photo (tools that take `id` make that photo active first). Typical loop: query_photos → select_photos (or pass id) → list_controls → set_develop {values: {"light.exposure": 0.5}} → render_photo to look at the result → export. Positions (crop rects, mask points, brush strokes) are normalized image coordinates 0..1 with the origin at the top-left. Every action is a command: list_commands shows ids and parameter docs; run_command runs any of them. Edits are undoable (undo / redo). Backend: remote 127.0.0.1:18991.

tools.description: Every command (engine + UI when connected) with id, label, menu, shortcut, parameter doc and whether it is enabled now. Each id is also callable as tool `cmd_<id with . replaced by _>` or via run_command.

filter.description: Only commands whose id or label contains this text (case-insensitive)

tools.name: list_commands
tools.title: List commands

tools.description: Run any LightCraft command by id with JSON params (see list_commands for ids and parameter docs), e.g. {command: "photo.rate", params: {rating: 4}}.
tools.name: run_command
tools.title: Run command

tools.description: Add image/raw files to the library. Folders are scanned recursively for photos; relative paths resolve against the server's working directory. The first imported photo becomes active. Returns the new photo ids.

album.description: Also add to this album id

mode.description: add (default) = reference the files in place; copy = copy them into `destination` (default: the library's Originals/); move = as copy, then each original and its XMP sidecars are removed from the source once the copy is verified and catalogued (duplicates and failures keep their sources; `kept` lists sources left in place and why; undo leaves the moved files at the destination)

organize.description: Copy or move: folders inside the destination — date (YYYY/YYYY-MM-DD, default), month (YYYY/YYYY-MM), flat, or a folder template such as {date:%Y}/{date:%Y%m%d} (→ 2026/20260114; the template's / make the levels, tokens as for rename; relative, no ..). Dated by capture time, else the import time

rename.description: Copy or move: file-name template, e.g. {date:%Y%m%d_%H%M%S}_{seq:3} (run_command photo.renameTokens lists the tags); the extension is kept

tools.name: import
tools.title: Import photos

tools.description: List photos (id, file name, size, rating, flag, edited…). Without filter/sort: the current library view.
tools.name: query_photos
tools.title: Query photos

tools.description: Set the selection; the active photo (the one develop tools edit) is `active` or the first id.
tools.name: select_photos
tools.title: Select photos

tools.description: Every develop slider (id like `light.exposure`, label, section, min, max, default, current value) for the active photo.

section.description: Only this section (e.g. light, color, effects, detail)

tools.name: list_controls
tools.title: List develop controls

tools.description: The full develop settings JSON of a photo (white balance, light, color, curves, mixer, grading, effects, crop, masks, spots…).

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo). Makes that photo active first.

tools.name: get_develop
tools.title: Get develop settings

tools.description: Edit a photo (one undo step each for values and settings). `values` sets sliders by control id (see list_controls), e.g. {"light.exposure": 0.7, "light.contrast": 20}. `settings` deep-merges a partial develop-settings JSON (as returned by get_develop).

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo). Makes that photo active first.

tools.name: set_develop
tools.title: Set develop settings

tools.description: Apply a develop preset (ids from cmd_presets_list) to the selection or `ids`, at `amount` percent (0..200, default 100).
tools.name: apply_preset
tools.title: Apply preset

tools.description: Set the crop of the active photo: `rect` [x0,y0,x1,y1] in normalized coordinates (0..1, origin top-left) of the straightened frame, `angle` in degrees. `reset: true` clears it. Give at least one of them.

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo). Makes that photo active first.

tools.name: crop
tools.title: Crop / straighten

tools.description: Render a photo with its current develop settings (cropped) and return it as an image so you can look at the result.

format.description: Image encoding (default png; jpeg is smaller)

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo). Makes that photo active first.

path.description: Also save the rendered file here

tools.name: render_photo
tools.title: Render photo

tools.description: Render and write photos. Give `path` (one photo; format from the extension unless `format` is set) or `dir` (batch, file names from `naming`).

bitDepth.description: Bits per channel: PNG 8|16 (default 8), TIFF 8|16|32 (default 16; 32 = linear float with a linear profile), AVIF 8|10; JPEG/WebP are 8-bit

colorSpace.description: Output colour space (default sRGB; AVIF is always sRGB). adobeRgb = Adobe RGB (1998) compatible; the embedded ICC profile is generated from the published primaries

dontEnlarge.description: Never upscale past the photo's own size (default true)

format.description: original = the file as is + an XMP sidecar with the edits; dng = raw photos as DNG with the edits embedded

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo). Makes that photo active first.

ids.description: Photos to export (default: the given/active photo)

limitKb.description: JPEG: largest quality that fits this many KB

longEdge.description: Output long edge in px. When no size param is given: 3000; 0 = full size (cropped, native resolution)

percent.description: Output size as a percentage of full size

ppi.description: Print resolution written into the file (default 240)

watermark.description: Text, or {text, vertical (boolean; defaults to false), size (fraction of short edge), opacity, anchor (topLeft|top|topRight|left|center|right|bottomLeft|bottom|bottomRight), inset, color [r,g,b], shadow}

width.description: Output width in px (with height: fit inside width × height, either orientation)

tools.name: export
tools.title: Export photo

tools.description: Capture the LightCraft window (after pending renders finish) and return it as an image.

maxSize.description: Downscale so the long edge is at most this (default 1600)

tools.name: screenshot
tools.title: Screenshot

tools.description: UI state: view, open panel, window and image rects, active photo, selection, active mask, status.
tools.name: inspect_ui
tools.title: Inspect UI

tools.description: Merge UI state, e.g. {"view": "detail"} (photoGrid|squareGrid|detail|compare) (see inspect_ui for fields).
tools.name: set_ui
tools.title: Set UI state

tools.description: On-screen widgets by automation id with rects [x, y, w, h] in screen points.
tools.name: list_widgets
tools.title: List widgets

tools.description: Click a widget by automation id (`widget`, see list_widgets) or a screen point (`x`, `y`). `count: 2` double-clicks.
tools.name: click
tools.title: Click

tools.description: Press a key with optional modifiers (shortcuts), e.g. {key: "Z", cmd: true}. Names: A–Z, 0–9, Enter, Escape, Delete, Left/Right/Up/Down, Space, Tab, F1… .
tools.name: press_key
tools.title: Press key

tools.description: Type text into the focused field.
tools.name: type_text
tools.title: Type text

tools.description: Replay a pointer gesture on the photo in normalized image coordinates (0..1, origin top-left): brush strokes, gradient drags, crop handles, heal spots. Needs the Detail view.
tools.name: pointer_gesture
tools.title: Pointer gesture
